meta.title: HR压价不要慌：弹性五步法反败为胜
meta.title_en: Five Steps to Win the Salary Negotiation

scenes.title_en: Clarify the structure, see through the tactics
scenes.context: 讲者给出前两步：追问薪资结构、拆穿HR四种惯用压价理由。
sentences: 90%的人会遭遇压价，不懂谈判技巧，只能被HR拿捏得死死的。
Nine out of ten people face lowball offers; without negotiation skills, HR has you on a leash.
被拿捏：have you on a leash
年薪还是月薪？税前还是税后？12薪还是14薪？
Annual or monthly? Before or after tax? 12 or 14 monthly paychecks?
薪资结构：pay structure
这一类的说辞，几乎对所有的求职者都是通吃的。
These lines are played on every single candidate — it's a standard script.
通吃：played on everyone
paraphrase: Align the definition before discussing numbers.
Lowball scripts are standard operating procedure.
scenes.speak: Nine out of ten people face lowball offers; without negotiation skills, HR has you on a leash. Annual or monthly? Before or after tax? 12 or 14 monthly paychecks? These lines are played on every single candidate — it's a standard script.

scenes.title_en: Hold firm on your expected salary
scenes.context: 讲者给出最关键的第三步：坚定期望薪资并给出合理理由。
sentences: 第三步最关键，直接决定你是不是能够逆风翻盘。
Step three is the make-or-break — it decides whether you can turn the tables.
逆风翻盘：turn the tables
紧扣岗位胜任的要求，符合过往工作中的亮点和突出成绩。
Anchor on the role's requirements and your track record of wins.
过往亮点：track record of wins
期望薪资是结合之前的收入，再加上现在市场的水平去定档的。
My expectation is benchmarked against my past pay plus the current market rate.
市场水平：market rate
scenes.speak: Step three is the make-or-break — it decides whether you can turn the tables. Anchor on the role's requirements and your track record of wins. My expectation is benchmarked against my past pay plus the current market rate.

scenes.title_en: Ask HR to fight for you, then compromise
scenes.context: 讲者给出第四五步：向HR传递诚意稳定性与offer信息，最后折中到转正定薪。
sentences: 向HR传递三个信息：诚意、稳定性、还有其他offer。
Send HR three signals: your commitment, your stability, and your other offers.
传递信息：send signals
这三个信息加持，会让HR更有动力、更有紧迫感地去帮你申请。
These signals push HR to work harder and faster on your application.
紧迫感：a sense of urgency
把期望薪资约定成转正工资，试用期工资不低于80%。
Set your expected salary for after probation, with the trial wage at no less than 80%.
转正工资：post-probation salary
paraphrase: Give HR a reason to fight for you.
最后留一个双方可接受的出口
Leave an exit both sides can accept.
scenes.speak: Send HR three signals: your commitment, your stability, and your other offers. These signals push HR to work harder and faster on your application. Set your expected salary for after probation, with the trial wage at no less than 80%.

practice: Could you break down the pay structure for me?
My expectation is based on my past pay and the market rate.
I'm fully committed — could you help push this through?
How about the expected salary after probation, with the trial at 80%?
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：HR holds me very tightly.
✓ 地道说法：HR has you on a leash.
被拿捏→have someone on a leash。
✓ 地道说法：12 or 14 monthly paychecks?
✕ 直译腔：The probation salary is not lower than 80%.
✓ 地道说法：The trial wage at no less than 80%.
试用期→trial period / probation；不低于→no less than。
shifts: 识破通吃话术，保持淡定
用转正定薪的折中方案收尾
footer_notes: ASR 校正：「over 9个」校正为「90%的人」、「基板工资 技巧奖金」校正为「基本工资 绩效奖金」、「机械表现」校正为「实际表现」、「同吃」校正为「通吃」、「保持谈定」校正为「保持淡定」、「坚定期望行资」校正为「坚定期望薪资」、「岗位胜利的要求」校正为「岗位胜任的要求」、「适用期」校正为「试用期」。
